tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled smooth base-field and sink-gradient mechanism numerically, allowing the substrate saturation scale to be learned. Fresh confirmation will determine whether this stationary model reaches the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the observed gradient dependence; the low-gradient probe also shows a strong response at higher substrate.
A saturating substrate response with gradient attenuation better matches the reported mechanistic signatures.
The observed gradients do not reach the recalled supercritical range, so its threshold and strength cannot be identified.
The open-branch and trajectory probes have already supplied nine observations; a fresh model confirmation is the next informative step.
